# DCMTK 3.7.0

This directory contains the repository-owned Windows x64 Release package used
by `qt6_viewer`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/DCMTK/dcmtk/tree/DCMTK-3.7.0
- Compiler: Microsoft Visual Studio 2022, x64
- Linkage: static libraries, dynamic MSVC runtime
- Dictionary: built in
- Optional external codecs and TLS: disabled

The upstream copyright and license terms are retained in
`share/doc/dcmtk-3.7.0/COPYRIGHT`.
